+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict, Iterable, List, Optional
+
+from openai import OpenAI
+
+
+DEFAULT_MODEL = os.getenv("OPENAI_MODEL", "openai/gpt-5.4-mini")
+DEFAULT_REQUIRED_FIELDS = ("vendor", "date", "total")
+MIN_CONFIDENCE = float(os.getenv("DOCUMENT_MIN_CONFIDENCE", "0.75"))
+
+
+def _coerce_confidence(value: Any) -> Optional[float]:
+    if value is None:
+        return None
+    if isinstance(value, (int, float)):
+        num = float(value)
+    elif isinstance(value, str):
+        cleaned = value.strip().replace(",", "")
+        if not cleaned:
+            return None
+        try:
+            num = float(cleaned)
+        except ValueError:
+            return None
+    else:
+        return None
+    if num < 0:
+        return 0.0
+    if num > 1:
+        if num <= 100:
+            return num / 100.0
+        return 1.0
+    return num
+
+
+def _missing_fields(document_fields: Dict[str, Any], required_fields: Iterable[str]) -> List[str]:
+    missing = []
+    for field in required_fields:
+        value = document_fields.get(field)
+        if value is None:
+            missing.append(field)
+        elif isinstance(value, str) and not value.strip():
+            missing.append(field)
+    return missing
+
+
+def validate_document_fields(
+    document_fields: Dict[str, Any],
+    required_fields: Optional[Iterable[str]] = None,
+    min_confidence: Optional[float] = None,
+    model: Optional[str] = None,
+) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    client = OpenAI(api_key=os.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY"))
+    required = tuple(required_fields) if required_fields is not None else DEFAULT_REQUIRED_FIELDS
+    threshold = MIN_CONFIDENCE if min_confidence is None else float(min_confidence)
+    missing = _missing_fields(document_fields, required)
+    confidence = _coerce_confidence(
+        document_fields.get("confidence")
+        or document_fields.get("overall_confidence")
+        or document_fields.get("score")
+    )
+    confidence_ok = confidence is None or confidence >= threshold
+    validation_payload = {
+        "required_fields": list(required),
+        "missing_fields": missing,
+        "confidence": confidence,
+        "min_confidence": threshold,
+        "confidence_ok": confidence_ok,
+        "document_fields": document_fields,
+    }
+    response = client.responses.create(
+        model=model or DEFAULT_MODEL,
+        input=[
+            {
+                "role": "system",
+                "content": "Validate structured document extraction results for required fields and confidence scores. Return a concise JSON-compatible assessment.",
+            },
+            {
+                "role": "user",
+                "content": str(validation_payload),
+            },
+        ],
+    )
+    text = getattr(response, "output_text", None)
+    result = {
+        "provider": "openai",
+        "model": model or DEFAULT_MODEL,
+        "required_fields": list(required),
+        "missing_fields": missing,
+        "confidence": confidence,
+        "min_confidence": threshold,
+        "confidence_ok": confidence_ok,
+        "valid": not missing and confidence_ok,
+    }
+    if text:
+        result["assessment"] = text
+    return result
*** End Patch

+import base64
+import json
+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
+
+from openai import OpenAI
+
+MODEL_ID = "gpt-4o-mini"
+
+
+def _to_data_uri(image_bytes: bytes, mime_type: str = "image/png") -> str:
+    return f"data:{mime_type};base64,{base64.b64encode(image_bytes).decode('utf-8')}"
+
+
+def _normalize_line_items(items: Any) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
+    if not isinstance(items, list):
+        return []
+    normalized = []
+    for item in items:
+        if isinstance(item, dict):
+            normalized.append({
+                "description": item.get("description") or item.get("name") or item.get("item"),
+                "quantity": item.get("quantity"),
+                "unit_price": item.get("unit_price") or item.get("price"),
+                "amount": item.get("amount") or item.get("total"),
+            })
+    return normalized
+
+
+def extract_invoice_fields(document: bytes, mime_type: str = "image/png", client: Optional[OpenAI] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    api_key = os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY")
+    if client is None:
+        client = OpenAI(api_key=api_key)
+    prompt = (
+        "Extract structured invoice fields as JSON with keys: vendor, date, total, line_items. "
+        "Line items must be a list of objects with description, quantity, unit_price, and amount when available. "
+        "Return only valid JSON."
+    )
+    response = client.chat.completions.create(
+        model=MODEL_ID,
+        messages=[
+            {"role": "system", "content": "You extract invoice fields."},
+            {"role": "user", "content": [
+                {"type": "text", "text": prompt},
+                {"type": "image_url", "image_url": {"url": _to_data_uri(document, mime_type)}},
+            ]},
+        ],
+        response_format={"type": "json_object"},
+        temperature=0,
+    )
+    content = response.choices[0].message.content or "{}"
+    data = json.loads(content)
+    return {
+        "vendor": data.get("vendor"),
+        "date": data.get("date"),
+        "total": data.get("total"),
+        "line_items": _normalize_line_items(data.get("line_items")),
+    }
